title: Turn a borrowed view into owned text
prompt: Remove leading and trailing ASCII space characters from the view and return an owning std::string. Keep internal spaces. The view may cover only part of a larger buffer; do not assume a terminating zero byte.

tests.label: Both ends
tests.hint: Keep the inner space while trimming the ends.

tests.label: All spaces
tests.hint: Handle a view with no non-space character.

tests.label: Empty view
tests.hint: Do not subtract indices before checking npos.

tests.label: View length matters
tests.hint: Respect the view length instead of treating data() as a C string.

hints: find_first_not_of and find_last_not_of can locate the kept range.
A returned string copies the selected characters into its own storage.
explanation: The view borrows existing bytes. Constructing a string from its subview creates an owning result whose lifetime does not depend on the original buffer.
chapterTitle: Building Data Pipelines with Ranges and Views
